thread:
Maya: Quick sync — eligibility scrub for the next design partner wave. goal: avoid ops overload while keeping enough variety. can we finalize filters today?
Lucas: Ops capacity is ~40 active DP seats concurrently. if we invite 120, expect ~25% show, so ~30 active. need headroom for bursts (~10%).
Priya: Suggest two buckets: high-touch (20) + self-serve (80). high-touch = onprem/private or heavy infra customers. self-serve = hosted + light usage.
Ben: For high-touch we should require: security review completed OR existing NDA + committed PO. otherwise they'll clog support.
Maya: Agreed. can we define an "eligibility scrub" scoring so invites are deterministic? short JSON we can run against spreadsheet?
Lucas: yes — keeping it simple. runbook will reject anything with unresolved infra tickets. ops-bot: queued a check on tickets for sample list. :gear:
Priya: Proposed scoring (weights): product-fit 40, infra-risk 30, strategic-value 20, timezone/region balance 10. threshold 60+.
Ben: +1. also add a hard exclude: active incident in last 30d or pending data residency exception.
Maya: paste example snippet I had in mind: 
```json
{
  "product_fit": 45,
  "infra_risk": 20,
  "strategic_value": 15,
  "region_balance": 5,
  "score": 85
}
```
Lucas: Nice. ops needs one more field: "ops_blockers": ["open_tickets", "requires_onprem_network"] so we can auto-fail.
Maya: Good call. we'll run this against the 250-candidate list and surface top 120. Priya — can you prioritize churn-risk customers within strategic_value so sales is happy?
Priya: yep — will add priority flag and surface a top-20 strategic list.
Ben: Launch gating thoughts: must have 2 canary partners (high-touch) for 2 weeks with monitoring, and automatic rollback if latency > 2x baseline or error rate > 1% for 24h.
Maya: acceptance criteria: onvocab tests pass, example prompts from customers produce comparable quality to hosted baseline, and runbook for support handoff documented.
Lucas: ops readiness checklist: capacity plan, emergency rollback playbook, contact list, and test traffic generator. I can own test generator.
ops-bot: scheduled: invite-scrub-run at 1704210800. will post results in #product-invite-results.
Maya: action items: Lucas -> add ops_blockers field to validator by EOD, Priya -> finalize priority flag + send prioritized CSV by 170420: 1800, Ben -> draft canary monitoring dashboard, Maya -> finalize invite templates and acceptance checklist.
Priya: tiny ask — include a short opt-out flow in the invite so we don't spam them if they're not ready. small UX tweak but reduces churn.
Maya: agreed. include a one-click decline and reason dropdown. done. :thumbsup:
Ben: one more risk: private customers might require dedicated infra before launch. include a gating note for engineering lead signoff.
Maya: noted. ok team — we'll reconvene after the scrub run. thanks! :rocket:
